title: Your Life in a Movie: What Genre Defines Your Journey?
description: Just like every great film has its unique genre, your life story fits into a specific cinematic category. Discover whether you're living a blockbuster action-adventure, a heartfelt romance, a mind-bending thriller, or a magical fantasy!

questions.text: What motivates you the most in life?

options.text: Adventure and discovering new things
Deep connections with people I love
Solving mysteries and uncovering truths
Finding humor in everyday situations

questions.text: If life were a genre, yours would be...

options.text: Action-Adventure - fast-paced and exhilarating
Romance - emotional and heartfelt
Thriller-Mystery - suspenseful and unpredictable
Comedy - lighthearted and entertaining

action.title: Action-Adventure
action.description: Your life is an adrenaline-packed blockbuster! Like Indiana Jones or Marvel heroes, you thrive on excitement, challenge, and the thrill of the unknown. Your journey is filled with high-speed chases, heroic moments, and never-ending adventure. You're the hero who jumps into action without hesitation, always ready for the next big challenge. Your movie has explosions, daring escapes, and triumphant victories - definitely a summer blockbuster that keeps audiences on the edge of their seats!

romance.title: Romance
romance.description: Your life is a heartfelt love story! Like classic romantic films, your journey is centered around deep connections, emotional moments, and the beautiful complexity of human relationships. Your movie features sunset kisses, heartfelt confessions, and the tender journey of two souls finding each other. Whether it's a meet-cute in a coffee shop or a love that spans decades, your story is all about the power of love to transform lives.

thriller.title: Thriller-Mystery
thriller.description: Your life is a mind-bending thriller! Like Hitchcock or modern mystery films, your journey is full of suspense, unexpected twists, and kept secrets. Your movie has shadowy figures, cryptic clues, and moments that make audiences gasp. You're the detective who notices what others miss, always piece together the puzzle before the final reveal. Your story keeps everyone guessing until the very end!

comedy.title: Comedy
comedy.description: Your life is a feel-good comedy! Like the best comedies, your journey is filled with laughter, humorous mishaps, and heartwarming moments. Your movie has witty banter, awkward situations that somehow work out, and characters you can't help but love. You're the person who finds humor in everything and brings joy to those around you. Your story might not have explosions, but it has something equally powerful - the ability to make people laugh and feel good.

fantasy.title: Fantasy
fantasy.description: Your life is a magical fantasy epic! Like Lord of the Rings or Harry Potter, your journey transcends ordinary reality into worlds of wonder and imagination. Your movie features mythical creatures, ancient prophecies, and a hero's quest that changes the fate of worlds. You see possibilities others don't, believe in the impossible, and your story is written in the stars. Your life is truly magical!

drama.title: Drama
drama.description: Your life is a powerful drama! Like award-winning dramatic films, your journey explores the depths of human experience - joy and sorrow, triumph and defeat. Your movie has complex characters, emotional depth, and moments that leave audiences reflecting on life. You've faced challenges that shaped you, and your story is a testament to the human spirit. Your life may not have explosions or magic, but it has something profound - authentic human experience that resonates deeply.
